row.evidence: The pricing page's Authentication row reads "SSO + SAML + SCIM" only under Enterprise ("Let's talk"), and the SCIM docs say "SCIM is available to customers on our Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Team is $15/user/mo billed annually ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user/mo adds SAML/OIDC SSO; Enterprise (Contact Sales) adds SCIM, custom RBAC and audit logs. On-call is an extra $10 (Team) or $20 (Pro) per user/mo. Pricing is per paid Responder/On-call seat; Viewer seats are free. June's '~$50/u/mo' Enterprise estimate and the '$5,000 SCIM add-on' user report had no first-party source and were dropped. SCIM runs through a WorkOS-powered directory sync connection (featured IdPs plus Custom SCIM); no SCIM base URL, attribute list or endpoint reference is published. The public REST API (Team plan and up) can only list/read users and teams; no user create/deactivate endpoints.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Authentication row shows 'SSO' (Sign in with Slack/Microsoft, not SAML). API & Webhooks marked 'Not included' (aria-label in pricing table markup).

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: API & Webhooks marked 'Included' in pricing table markup. On-call +$10/user/mo.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs are Enterprise-only but delivered by log stream or CSV export, not via the API.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping in Settings > Permissions > SCIM assignment (base roles Standard/Admin/Owner plus custom roles); SCIM groups can also be mapped to on-call seats. Roles become read-only in incident.io.

limitations.text: A user deactivated in the IdP can stay active through their Slack or Microsoft Teams membership.
Only groups explicitly pushed from the IdP are synced.
SCIM connection is a WorkOS-powered directory sync flow; no incident.io-hosted SCIM base URL, token or attribute schema is documented.
Email invites are disabled once SCIM is enabled.

rate_limits.text: Default 1,200 requests/minute per API key; some endpoints lower.

limitations.text: The Users API is read-only (list/show users, paging-provider preference); no create, update-role or deactivate endpoints.

okta.notes: OIN search returned no incident.io app; incident.io documents Okta SCIM via its WorkOS-powered connection flow.

entra.notes: Not checked in the Entra gallery (no tutorial found at the usual Learn URLs); incident.io lists Entra ID as a featured SCIM provider.

google.notes: incident.io lists Google Workspace as a featured SCIM provider; no Google Marketplace/admin-help entry checked.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue not loadable; incident.io lists OneLogin as a featured SCIM provider.

jumpcloud.notes: incident.io lists JumpCloud as a featured SCIM provider.

fallbacks.other_sync: Accounts auto-created and deactivated from Slack workspace or Microsoft Teams membership

open_questions: SCIM base URL, auth token, version and supported user attributes are not documented (WorkOS-hosted connection).
Whether SCIM supports hard delete or reactivation is not documented.
Whether incident.io has its own Entra gallery, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogue app is unconfirmed.
Whether Pro's $25 is annual or monthly pricing is not stated on the page.
Whether webhooks cover user lifecycle events: the webhook spec lists only private-incident membership events.
